args.title: Bellwether Returns: Main Post + Subscriber Companion (3-Bullet Summary)
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/returns and its subscriber companion (https://insights.bellwether.example/returns/companion, accessed with team code SUB-3344):

- Apparel return rates have reached 24%.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling cost by a fifth (~20%).
- Resale within 10 days kept most of the margin.
